findings.summary: The manifest and this fragment state the dispatch-base node gate ran 4 failed / 4 passed at 9ac9d2af9f, but no log for that arm survives on disk and test_logs cites base-arm.log, which now holds the 10-passed scoped-suite arm; the base measurement is claimed rather than recorded. The negative-control log at head with the opt-in made a no-op reproduces the same four ids, so the claim is corroborated but not base-logged.

test_a_no_change_patch_leaves_the_file_untouched asserts only that the file's text is unchanged, so a regression that rewrote byte-identical content (a write where none should occur) would still pass; the assertion does not measure the no-write it claims.

VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_derived_impl_drops_the_authored_meta.py covering cases (a)-(f) with (a),(d),(e),(f) red at the dispatch base; the file adds exactly those six cases (tests/test_a_derived_impl_drops_the_authored_meta.py:173-308) and head-arm.log records 18 passed, EXIT=0, while the base 4-failed result has no surviving log (see FINDING).
VERDICT write_paths: the declared scope is reckon/_plan_html.py, reckon/_store.py, reckon/serve.py, reckon/tags.py, tests/test_a_derived_impl_drops_the_authored_meta.py and the plan fragment/figures; every diff path lies inside it except tests/test_landing_append_is_commutative.py and tests/test_section_body_records_are_read.py, which the resume advice grants explicitly.

JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_derived_impl_drops_the_authored_meta.py:181 asserts no plan-impl meta against independent literals, and negative-control.log shows the same suite red (4 failed) when the opt-in is made a no-op, while the no-change assertion at line 203 is weaker than its claim.

SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the change extends write_state and calls the existing _remove_meta at reckon/_plan_html.py:2037 rather than introducing a second meta-removal mechanism.
FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/the-portfolio-reads-true/a-derived-impl-drops-the-authored-meta.html:51 non-blocking: the dispatch-base gate result is recorded only in prose while base-arm.log holds the 10-passed suite arm, so the base measurement cannot be opened.
FINDING tests/test_a_derived_impl_drops_the_authored_meta.py:203 non-blocking: the no-change assertion compares content only and would pass on a byte-identical rewrite, so it does not prove no write occurred.
